senses.example: Hoy hace mucho calor en Pamplona.
senses.exampleGloss: It is very hot in Pamplona today.

alternatives.reason: Humid, stifling heat; stronger and more colloquial than calor.
Measured temperature, not the felt heat.
The personal feeling of being overwhelmed by heat; narrower.

notes: hace calor is the fixed Peninsular pattern; do not translate 'it is hot' as es caliente.
